rules: Place or habitat words alone do not establish captivity or cultivation. An explicit provider wild flag remains required.

Explicit captive, captivity, cultivated, cultivation, cultured, planted or planting language in seven context fields remains held for context review; negation and other-organism references are not automatically resolved.
All original snapshot, exact taxon, county, coordinate uncertainty, date-presence and record-status filters remain enforced. This version does not fix general date validation.
Accept only documented historical occurrence. Original observation dates and original provider retrieval timestamps are preserved separately from new interpretation time.
Replay only immutable committed original responses with verified artifact hashes, parameters, complete requested outcomes and contiguous complete pagination. No provider fallback.

This pilot selects CC0 and CC BY observation metadata. It does not impose a new universal metadata license policy or conclude all BY-NC facts are unusable. Media reuse requires its own license; no media downloaded.

primaryReferences.supports: Source wild classification concerns organism intentional presence; a wild organism can occur in gardens, zoos, buildings or as a hitchhiker.
Observation metadata and media can carry different licenses; GBIF accepts CC0, BY and BY-NC; treatment of factual observations and narrative descriptions differs.

checks.coverage: Eight real retained responses plus corruption, total, completeness, scope, snapshot, license and network-fallback failure cases.
